title: [Kampala YC W26] Reverse-Engineer Apps into APIs — HTS Win32 automation pattern
desc: Kampala (YC W26) reverse-engineers apps into APIs by analyzing network traffic and UI patterns. Applicable to WKAppBot for MFC/HTS apps with no UIA support.
steps: CONCEPT: When UIA returns nothing useful, Kampala-style approach sniffs app network calls or Win32 messages to discover the app's own internal API. For WKAppBot: combine with WM_COPYDATA / RegisterWindowMessage to talk to HTS/MFC apps directly.
author: claude
